column2:
Principle 5: Businesses should
uphold the effective abolition
of child labour.
column3:
• Centum and its investee companies does not employ children in a manner
that is economically exploitative or is likely to be hazardous or to interfere with
the child’s education, or to be harmful to the child’s health or physical, mental,
spiritual, moral or social development.
• We conduct due diligence to prevent the use of child labour in the business,
portfolio companies, and supply chain.

column2:
Principle 6: Businesses should
uphold the elimination of
discrimination in respect of
employment and occupation.
column3:
• We promote a diverse workforce
• 50:50 gender ratio for men and women at the board level and across the
workforce. We are working towards achieving 50:50 parity at the management
level.
• Since 2023, Centum has maintained a zero gender pay gap between its male
and female staff affirming its commitment on fair compensation.
• Centum now reports zero gender pay gap - Business Daily.

column2:
Principle 7: Businesses should
support a precautionary
approach to environmental
challenges.
column3:
• Deliberate measures to reduce the carbon footprint, promote energy efficiency,
and adoption of green energy.
• We also undertake as required by regulators, Environmental impact
assessments (EIA) before projects and developments.

column2:
Principle 8: Businesses
should undertake initiatives to
promote greater environmental
responsibility.
column3:
• Tree planting initiatives that also contribute to the national tree planting
programme and goals.
• 30 per cent of our developments dedicated to green landscaped spaces under
our “Green by Design” approach.
• Carbon footprint reduction mainly through adoption of solar power technology.
• Energy efficiency – Solar installations at Two Rivers complex for residential and
commercial use, with a capacity of 1.2 MW.
• Water desalination at Vipingo thus reducing pressure on scarce fresh water
resources.
• Water recycling at Two Rivers complex: 85 per cent of waste water recycled
and reused within the facility.

column2:
Principle 9: Businesses
should encourage the
development and diffusion
of environmentally friendly
technologies.
column3:
• Solar energy technology adopted at Two Rivers. In 2024, we were in the final
stages of sealing a strategic partnership to increase solar power output from
1.2 MW to 3.2 MW.
• Green building certifications, such as EDGE Certification for South Tower. We
plan to achieve 80% EDGE certification for all our projects by 2027.

column2:
Principle 10: Businesses
should work against corruption
in all its forms, including
extortion and bribery.
column3:
• We implement high corporate governance standards, including zero
tolerance towards fraud, corruption, and bribery, while promoting a culture of
transparency and accountability across all business operations.
• Implementation of a whistle-blowing policy including launch of the
Whistleblowing Portal in Nov of 2024.
